questions.question: What is the highest civilian award of Mauritius received by PM Modi?

questions.solution:

questions.question: Which organization received the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**INCOIS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)** has been honored with the Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar for 2025.
 
• INCOIS runs the **Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre**, recognized by UNESCO for its excellence in tsunami monitoring and alert dissemination.
 
• Its advisories significantly aided in disaster response during **Cyclone Phailin (2013)** and **Cyclone Hudhud (2014)**.
 
• Technologies like **SARAT** support the Indian Coast Guard in search and rescue missions, and **SynOPS** integrates real-time oceanic data to bolster disaster management.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar**: India’s prestigious award honoring outstanding contributions in the field of disaster management.
 
• **INCOIS**: Functions under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, providing essential ocean-based information, early warnings, and advisories for natural disasters.
 
• **Indian Tsunami Early Warning Centre**: A UNESCO-certified system offering real-time monitoring to protect coastal populations from tsunamis.
 
• **SARAT and SynOPS**: Advanced tools enhancing search and rescue operations, as well as real-time data integration for robust disaster response.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **INCOIS Achievements**__

 __
 
• Developed early warning solutions to safeguard lives and property in coastal regions.
 
• Internationally recognized for tsunami warning capabilities, particularly after the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Award**__
 
 
• Named after Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose, reflecting courage and dedication to public service.
 
• Awards individuals and organizations demonstrating exemplary work in disaster risk reduction and management.

questions.question: How many journalists were felicitated at the 19th Ramnath Goenka Award for Excellence in Journalism 2025?
questions.solution:

• **President Droupadi Murmu** was the chief guest at the **19th Ramnath Goenka Award for Excellence in Journalism 2025**.
 
• The winners were presented with a **citation**, a **trophy**, and a **cash prize** of **₹1 lakh**.
 
• The award honors journalists in **Print/Digital & Broadcast journalism**.
 
• **Mridulika Jha** of **Aaj Tak** won the award for her coverage of the **“Dunki route”**, a method used by youths from Haryana to illegally enter the **United States**.

• The award, first given in **2005**, recognizes journalists who display **courage** and **excellence** in their work, often in the face of significant **political and economic pressures**.

questions.question: How many total Padma Awards have been announced by the Government of India for the year 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**139**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Padma Awards 2025 announced.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Padma Awards **- one of the highest civilian Awards of the country, are conferred in three categories, namely, **Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.**
 
• The Awards are given in various disciplines/ fields of activities, viz.- art, social work, public affairs, science and engineering, trade and industry, medicine, literature and education, sports, civil service, etc.
 
• **‘Padma Vibhushan’** is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service; **‘Padma Bhushan’** for distinguished service of high order and **‘Padma Shri’** for distinguished service in any field.
 
• The awards are announced on the occasion of Republic Day every year.
 
• These Awards are conferred by the President of India at ceremonial functions which are held at RashtrapatiBhawan usually around March/ April every year. 
 
• For the year 2025, the President has approved conferment of **139 Padma Awards including 1 duo case (in a duo case, the Award is counted as one)**. 
 
• The list comprises **7 Padma Vibhushan**, **19 Padma Bhushan** and **113 Padma Shri Awards**. 
 
• **23 of the awardees are women** and the list also includes **10 persons from the category of Foreigners/NRI/PIO/OCI** and **13 Posthumous awardees**.
 
• Go through this link for all the winners: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2096285

questions.question: Which RBI digital initiatives were recognized for the Digital Transformation Award 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Pravaah and Sarthi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• RBI awarded digital transformation Award 2025 for digital initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** was awarded the **Digital Transformation Award 2025** by **Central Banking** at London for its digital initiatives.
 
• The two initiatives recognized are **Pravaah** and **Sarthi**, both developed by RBI’s **in-house developer team**.
 
• **Sarthi** (launched in **January 2023**) digitized RBI’s **internal workflows**, enabling secure storage and sharing of documents, improving **record management**, and automating processes.
 
• **Sarthi** integrates task tracking, performance monitoring, and collaboration, replacing fragmented manual and digital processes.
 
• **Pravaah**, launched in **May 2024**, provides a **digitized platform** for **external users** to submit **regulatory applications** to the RBI.
 
• Documents submitted via **Pravaah** are processed and integrated into the **Sarthi database**, ensuring secure handling across RBI offices with centralized **cybersecurity systems**.
